rubric.evidence: Verified directly against W3C Window Management §3.2.2-3.2.6 & §3.6.1-3.6.2, Blink additional_windowing_controls.idl/.cc, media_query_evaluator.cc, runtime_enabled_features.json5 (ChromeOS stable / default experimental), BCD api/Window.json & css/at-rules/media.json, webstatus.dev, WPT, and ChromeStatus 5201832664629248 on 2026-11-27.

Feature 5201832664629248 is listed under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=155 with exact listing name 'Additional Windowing Controls'; slug additional-windowing-controls matches slugify(); H1 matches listing name; declared ChromeStatus table row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5201832664629248.

Full reference covers all 6 surfaces (maximize, minimize, restore, setResizable, @media display-state, @media resizable) across all 9 reference-contract dimensions, including the setResizable() no-user-activation rule, child-frame media-query clamping, and Blink InvalidStateError vs. spec NotAllowedError behavior.

Explains VDI and custom-titlebar use cases, distinguishes ChromeOS default-on shipping from the non-ChromeOS desktop flag, documents restore() state transitions from minimized/maximized/fullscreen, and clarifies MDN's legacy Netscape 4.x Window.setResizable() page.

Provides complete JS titlebar controller, CSS @media rules, and matchMedia() state observer snippets verified by doc-tests.mjs, plus links to all 4 verified HTTP-200 Chrome Platform Showcase concept demos.

Honest Limited availability banner and tabular compat matrix citing BCD, webstatus.dev, Blink flags, and Firefox/Safari standards positions, with clear feature-detection and non-PWA fallback guidance.
Every visible source and citation label carries a direct external <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; CPS feature root and all 4 concept demos HEAD-checked HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions and <pre tabindex='0'>, and visible :focus-visible outline.

Uses shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, logical max-inline-size sizing, and horizontally scrollable .table-wrap containers without document horizontal overflow at mobile 360x740 or desktop 1280x800.

Links to https://chrome-platform-showcase.kinlan-test.workers.dev/v150/additional-windowing-controls/ (and its 4 concept demos, all HTTP 200; CPS conformance.json declares chromestatusId 5201832664629248). Intentionally not iframed because AWC requires a primary top-level installed PWA window and CPS hosts the suite under v150.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic HTML landmark navigation code blocks iframe embed
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a single <main> landmark, single <h1>, sequential heading hierarchy, semantic <header>/<nav>/<footer> landmarks, and <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-accessible scrollable code blocks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: structured article with single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer class='byline'>, sequential h2/h3 headings, and <pre tabindex='0'><code> on every code block.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation table scroll focus keyboard navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide keyboard-focusable scrollable containers with explicit region labels and visible :focus-visible rings for wide data tables so keyboard users can scroll without horizontal document overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: wrapped every .doc-table in <div class='table-wrap' tabindex='0' role='region'> with aria-label or aria-labelledby and a 3px var(--accent-blue) :focus-visible outline.
